subject: monstera
name: 龟背竹
label: 一片龟背竹
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One large heart-shaped monstera leaf with three broad edge splits and one central vein, no interior holes.
Complete subject inside the central 76% of the square, generous 12% clear margins on every side. Pure ink outlines only with blank interiors. No gray fills, leaf shading or surface texture. Keep each leaf to its clean silhouette and one main vein.
